metadata.title: IEESEC | Software Engineering Community at IHU
metadata.description: The Software Engineering student community of the Department of Information and Electronic Engineering at IHU. We build projects, share knowledge and grow together.
metadata.joinDescription: Apply to join IEESEC, the Software Engineering student community at the International Hellenic University.

hero.description: From curiosity to shipped projects, shared knowledge and a community that keeps moving with you.

images.campus3: International Hellenic University campus viewed from the surrounding grounds

sections.teamDescription: Engineering with purpose. Building as one.
sections.projectsDescription: We design and build applications that connect university knowledge with practical needs.
sections.eventsDescription: Workshops, talks and meet-ups where we test ideas and share what we learn.
sections.techDescription: The languages, frameworks and tools we use to design, build and ship our projects.

andreas.bio: Studies in the Department of Information and Electronic Engineering at IHU and actively experiments with different technologies and software stacks.

magda.bio: A second-year Information and Electronic Engineering student at IHU Thessaloniki, focused on backend development with Java and Spring Boot.

dimitris.bio: Works where code meets circuitry, pursuing clear solutions grounded in Computer Science and Electronics.

open-source.title: How we work on open-source projects
open-source.excerpt: From the first idea to the pull request, we organise collaboration so every member can contribute.

workshops.title: Workshops built around practice
workshops.excerpt: Focused sessions where we write code, answer questions and leave with something that works.

student-projects.title: What makes a student project useful
student-projects.excerpt: We choose problems with real context, a clear goal and room to learn through implementation.
